tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with the date of the last release of PSD Commodity Forecast Data.
Please note that there could be revision on the forecast numbers for multiple years on a given commodity, and so this API endpoint returns
set of records containing data release dates at a commodity level
Use this information to query for only the PSD Forecast data that has changed since last invocation of this API End point

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with Forecast number for a given Commodity Code (Ex, 0440000 for Corn) and a given Market Year (Ex, 2017) for 
all applicable countries. PSD Database has data for most commodities since year 1960.
Please see Commodities end point to get a list of all PSD Commodities with corresponding Commodity Code.

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with Forecast number for a given Commodity Code (Ex, 0440000 for Corn) and a given Market Year (Ex, 2017) for 
a given Country (Ex, BR for Brazil). PSD Database has data for most commodities since year 1960.
Please see Commodities end point to get a list of all PSD Commodities with corresponding Commodity Code, and Countries end point for a list of all countries
with corresponding Country Code

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with Forecast number for a given Commodity Code (Ex, 0440000 for Corn) and a given Market Year (Ex, 2017) for 
the world.Data from all applicable countries are aggregated together for reporting it at the World Level.
PSD Database has data for most commodities since year 1960.
Please see Commodities end point to get a list of all PSD Commodities with corresponding Commodity Code.

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with data for the Regions as classified in PSD System. 
This data could be used to correlate the Region Name based on region code in the Data returned by Countries End Point

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with data for Countries and the corresponding Region Code the Country belongs to.
This data could be used to correlate the Country Name based on country code in the data returned by other end points returning Commodity Forecasts.

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with data for Commodities with the corresponding Commodity Code. 
This data could be used to correlate the Commodity Name based on the Commodity Code in the data returned by other end points returning Commodity Forecasts.

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with data for Units Of Measure with the corresponding Units Of Measure Id. 
This data could be used to correlate the Unit of Measure Name based on the Id in the data returned by other end points returning Commodity Forecasts.

tags: PSD Data API - Production, Supply and Distribution Forecast Data of World Agricultural Commodities
get.summary:
Returns a set of records with data for Commodity Attribute Names with the corresponding Attribute Id. 
This data could be used to correlate theAttribute Name based on the Id in the data returned by other end points returning Commodity Forecasts.
PSD database tracks Commodity Forecast numbers across multiple attributes broadly classified under "Production", "Supply" and "Sistribution" categories.
